## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +4.96% | 1M: -10.33%) RECOVERY and SPY (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND, while TLT (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND — mixed confirmations of a non-directional market.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit/credit proxies mixed: HYG (1W: -0.22% | 1M: +0.44%) CORRECTION vs LQD (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +1.34%) ABOVE TREND, implying neutral credit signal. Volatility and equity breadth divergence — VXX RECOVERY (1W: +4.96% | 1M: -10.33%) alongside weak sector breadth (3/11) driving uncertainty.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Financial conditions tentatively easing: TLT (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +1.34%) ABOVE TREND. Dollar/FX gauges show no directional signal in the provided data (rates and FX neutral).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Biotech leading: XBI (1W: +10.73% | 1M: +13.82%) ABOVE TREND; Tech lagging in a pullback: XLK (1W: -1.70% | 1M: +1.60%) CORRECTION; Financials mixed: XLF (1W: -0.97% | 1M: +3.90%) CORRECTION — style mixed, no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities soft: SPY (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND while small caps show strength: IWM (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.31%) ABOVE TREND. China remains weak: FXI (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -8.21%) BELOW TREND and EM uneven: EEM (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +2.61%) CORRECTION.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation cooled: IBIT (1W: -8.88% | 1M: -21.16%) BELOW TREND and ETHA (1W: -11.96% | 1M: -23.44%) BELOW TREND. Momentum/quality holds some bid: MTUM (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +8.29%) ABOVE TREND and IWM ABOVE TREND indicate selective risk-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity weakness dominant: CPER (1W: -8.19% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND and GLD (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -11.58%) BELOW TREND, with broad metals (SLV/PALL) deeply negative — reflation trades under pressure.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy under pressure: XLE (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -9.30%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -7.18% | 1M: -25.93%) BELOW TREND. Natural gas shows divergent strength: UNG (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +7.22%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed pockets: XBI (1W: +10.73% | 1M: +13.82%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +12.00%) ABOVE TREND provide clear short-term leadership; major divergence flagged between SPY BELOW TREND and IWM ABOVE TREND plus VXX RECOVERY — market is bifurcated.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to demonstrated leaders and momentum ETFs (XBI (1W: +10.73% | 1M: +13.82%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +12.00%) ABOVE TREND, IWM (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.31%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to weak commodity and China exposures (GLD (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -11.58%) BELOW TREND, FXI (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -8.21%) BELOW TREND, IBIT (1W: -8.88% | 1M: -21.16%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Biotech/semis — XBI (1W: +10.73% | 1M: +13.82%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +12.00%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy and metals — XLE (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -9.30%) BELOW TREND, SLV (1W: -18.32% | 1M: -24.25%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Natural gas divergence — UNG (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +7.22%) CORRECTION. BEARISH: Broad oil and industrial metals — BNO (1W: -7.18% | 1M: -25.93%) BELOW TREND, CPER (1W: -8.19% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (vol threshold for complacency), HYG/LQD spread (credit health) watch for move >/ < par levels, XLK/XLF relative trend inflection to monitor for a style pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Biotech and momentum ETFs showing strength (XBI ABOVE TREND, SOXX ABOVE TREND); key risk is bifurcation — SPY BELOW TREND vs IWM ABOVE TREND and a VXX RECOVERY indicating uneven sentiment to monitor.
